entry.en: Your passport should be valid for the proposed duration of your stay, with no additional validity needed.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido durante la duración prevista de tu estancia, sin necesidad de validez adicional.
entry.quote: Your passport should be valid for the proposed duration of your stay. No additional period of validity is needed.

entry.en: To enter Niger you must have a certificate proving you have had a yellow fever vaccination.
entry.es: Para entrar en Níger debes tener un certificado que acredite la vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla.
entry.quote: To enter Niger, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination.

entry.en: Authorities have conducted enhanced security checks on foreign nationals arriving, and in some cases passports have been withheld for several days.
entry.es: Las autoridades han realizado controles de seguridad reforzados a extranjeros que llegan y, en algunos casos, han retenido pasaportes durante varios días.
entry.quote: Nigerien authorities have conducted enhanced security checks on foreign nationals arriving into Niger. In some cases, passports have been withheld for several days.

entry.en: There are strict rules about goods taken into or out of Niger, and you must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Hay normas estrictas sobre las mercancías que entran o salen de Níger y debes declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of Niger. You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

entry.en: You will be denied entry without a valid travel document or if you try to use a passport reported lost or stolen.
entry.es: Se te denegará la entrada si no tienes un documento de viaje válido o intentas usar un pasaporte declarado perdido o robado.
entry.quote: You will be denied entry if you do not have a valid travel document or try to use a passport that has been reported lost or stolen.

safety.en: Foreign nationals may travel outside Niamey only with government permission and an escort by Nigerien security and military forces.
safety.es: Los extranjeros solo pueden viajar fuera de Niamey con permiso del Gobierno y escoltados por fuerzas de seguridad y militares nigerinas.
safety.quote: The Government of Niger will only allow foreign nationals to travel outside of Niamey if you get their permission and are escorted by Nigerien security and military forces.

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Niger.
safety.es: Es muy probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Níger.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Niger.

safety.en: There is a very high threat of kidnapping throughout Niger, including Niamey.
safety.es: Hay una amenaza muy alta de secuestro en todo Níger, incluida Niamey.
safety.quote: There is a very high threat of kidnapping throughout Niger, including Niamey.

safety.en: Do not cross the bridges over the River Niger on foot at any time.
safety.es: No cruces a pie los puentes sobre el río Níger en ningún momento.
safety.quote: Do not cross the bridges over the River Niger on foot at any time.

safety.en: The areas around the Gaweye Hotel, National Museum and Petit Marché in Niamey are particularly prone to muggings.
safety.es: Las zonas del hotel Gaweye, el Museo Nacional y el Petit Marché de Niamey son especialmente propensas a atracos.
safety.quote: The areas around the Gaweye Hotel, National Museum and Petit Marché in Niamey are particularly prone to muggings.

safety.en: Same-sex relationships are illegal in Niger.
safety.es: Las relaciones entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales en Níger.
safety.quote: Same-sex relationships are illegal in Niger.

health.en: Medical facilities are poor even in Niamey, and serious treatment would require evacuation to Europe.
health.es: Los centros médicos son deficientes incluso en Niamey y un tratamiento grave requeriría evacuación a Europa.
health.quote: Medical facilities are poor, even in Niamey. Serious medical treatment would require evacuation to Europe.

health.en: Malaria is a problem in Niger and is chloroquine resistant.
health.es: La malaria es un problema en Níger y es resistente a la cloroquina.
health.quote: Malaria, including encephaletic malaria, is a problem, and is chloroquine resistant in Niger.

health.en: City tap water is reported to be well-chlorinated, but be particularly wary of well, stream and rural water.
health.es: Se informa de que el agua del grifo de las ciudades está bien clorada, pero hay que desconfiar especialmente del agua de pozo, de arroyo y rural.
health.quote: in a pinch, city tap water is reported to be well-chlorinated. Be particularly wary of well water, stream water, and rural water.

health.en: Schistosomiasis is present in most water bodies in Niger, so travellers should avoid going in the water except chlorinated pools.
health.es: La esquistosomiasis está presente en la mayoría de las masas de agua de Níger, por lo que se debe evitar bañarse salvo en piscinas cloradas.
health.quote: Schistosomiasis is present in most water bodies in Niger, so travellers should avoid going in the water everywhere — except chlorinated swimming pools.

health.en: Giardia and amoebic dysentery are common, so be wary of roadside food unless bought hot off the grill.
health.es: La giardia y la disentería amebiana son comunes, así que desconfía de la comida callejera salvo que la compres recién hecha en la parrilla.
health.quote: Giardia and amoebic dysentery are common. Be wary of any roadside food, unless you buy it hot off the grill.

health.en: Drink lots of water in Niger because the dry heat will dehydrate you and you may not realise it.
health.es: Bebe mucha agua en Níger porque el calor seco te deshidratará sin que lo notes.
health.quote: Drink lots and lots of water while in Niger because the dry heat will dehydrate you, and you may not realise.

help.en: Call 15 and ask for an ambulance.
help.es: Llama al 15 y pide una ambulancia.
help.quote: Call 15 and ask for an ambulance.

getting_in.en: There is one international airport, Diori Hamani International Airport in Niamey.
getting_in.es: Hay un aeropuerto internacional, el Aeropuerto Internacional Diori Hamani de Niamey.
getting_in.quote: There is one international airport (Aéroport International Diori Hamani de Niamey) in Niamey.

getting_in.en: As of August 2017 there were flights from West and North African capitals, Istanbul and Paris.
getting_in.es: En agosto de 2017 había vuelos desde capitales de África occidental y del norte, Estambul y París.
getting_in.quote: As of August 2017, there were flights from West and North African capitals, Istanbul, and Paris.

getting_in.en: Travellers can reach Niger overland by road from Mali, Burkina Faso, Benin and Nigeria.
getting_in.es: Se puede llegar a Níger por carretera desde Malí, Burkina Faso, Benín y Nigeria.
getting_in.quote: Travellers can get to Niger overland by roads from Mali, Burkina Faso, Benin and Nigeria.

getting_in.en: As of 2023, the text says it is probably safe to say that no land border should be considered safe to cross.
getting_in.es: En 2023, el texto afirma que probablemente se pueda decir que ningún paso fronterizo terrestre debe considerarse seguro.
getting_in.quote: It is probably safe to say that, as of 2023, no land border should be considered safe to cross.

getting_in.en: A number of private companies offer bus services from Niger to neighbouring countries and as far as Dakar and Nouakchott.
getting_in.es: Varias empresas privadas ofrecen autobuses desde Níger a países vecinos e incluso hasta Dakar y Nuakchot.
getting_in.quote: There are a number of private companies offering bus services from Niger to neighbouring countries and even as far as Dakar and Nouakchott

getting_around.en: Of 19,000 km of highways, around 4,000 km is paved, as of 2010.
getting_around.es: De 19.000 km de carreteras, unos 4.000 km están asfaltados, según datos de 2010.
getting_around.quote: Of the 19,000 km of highways, around 4,000 km is paved (as of 2010)

getting_around.en: Taxis in Niamey charge about CFA 200 for a short distance or CFA 400 for going almost across the city.
getting_around.es: Los taxis de Niamey cobran unos 200 CFA por distancias cortas o 400 CFA por cruzar casi toda la ciudad.
getting_around.quote: Taxis in Niamey charge about CFA 200 if the distance isn't too long, or CFA 400 for going almost across the city.

getting_around.en: The large buses are brand new Mercedes buses that carry a soldier at night so they may drive all night.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses grandes son Mercedes nuevos y llevan un soldado por la noche, por lo que pueden circular toda la noche.
getting_around.quote: The large buses are brand new Mercedes buses and they carry a soldier at night so they may drive all night long.

getting_around.en: A railway line exists between Niamey and Dosso, but as of 2024 no trains operate.
getting_around.es: Existe una línea de ferrocarril entre Niamey y Dosso, pero en 2024 no circulaba ningún tren.
getting_around.quote: A railway line exists between Niamey and Dosso, but as of 2024 there are no trains operating.

getting_around.en: As of March 2020, Niger Airlines operated flights between Niamey, Zinder, Agadez and Diffa.
getting_around.es: En marzo de 2020, Niger Airlines operaba vuelos entre Niamey, Zinder, Agadez y Diffa.
getting_around.quote: Niger Airlines operates flights between Niamey (NIM),  Zinder (ZDR), Agadez (AJY), and Diffa (DZRF) as of Mar 2020.

getting_around.en: FCDO advises avoiding buses or taxis where possible.
getting_around.es: El FCDO aconseja evitar autobuses y taxis siempre que sea posible.
getting_around.quote: Avoid using buses or taxis where possible.

money.en: The currency is the West African CFA franc (XOF).
money.es: La moneda es el franco CFA de África Occidental (XOF).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the West African CFA franc, denoted CFA (ISO currency code: XOF).

money.en: Niger is a cash-based society, credit cards are rarely accepted even in hotels, and there are few ATMs.
money.es: Níger es una sociedad basada en el efectivo, rara vez se aceptan tarjetas incluso en hoteles, y hay pocos cajeros.
money.quote: Niger is a cash-based society. Credit cards are rarely accepted even in hotels and restaurants visited by international clients. There are few ATMs.

money.en: US dollars and other foreign currency are not accepted in daily transactions, only for exchange into local money.
money.es: Los dólares y otras divisas no se aceptan en transacciones diarias, solo para cambiarlos por moneda local.
money.quote: US dollars and other foreign currency are not accepted in daily transactions, only to exchange into local money via a bank or black market.

money.en: Ecobank ATMs in Niger take Mastercard and Visa cards.
money.es: Los cajeros de Ecobank en Níger aceptan tarjetas Mastercard y Visa.
money.quote: Ecobank take Mastercard and Visa card at their ATMs in Niger.

money.en: Be careful with street ATMs, never use them at night, and if possible use the ATMs in large hotels.
money.es: Ten cuidado con los cajeros de la calle, no los uses de noche y, si es posible, usa los de los grandes hoteles.
money.quote: Be careful when using ATMs on the street, never do this at night-time, and if possible use the ATMs available in most large hotels.

money.en: Bargaining and haggling is essential and expected.
money.es: Regatear es esencial y se espera.
money.quote: Bargaining and haggling is essential and expected.

etiquette.en: Dress conservatively: no shorts, no skirts above the knees and no tank tops.
etiquette.es: Viste de forma conservadora: sin pantalones cortos, sin faldas por encima de la rodilla y sin camisetas de tirantes.
etiquette.quote: Dress conservatively, which means no shorts, no skirts above the knees, and no tank tops.

etiquette.en: Always ask before photographing people, as many Nigeriens still find it offensive.
etiquette.es: Pregunta siempre antes de fotografiar a las personas, ya que muchos nigerinos aún lo consideran ofensivo.
etiquette.quote: Always ask people, especially camel drivers, market sellers, and the elderly, before taking a photograph. Many Nigeriens still find it offensive.

etiquette.en: Islam is the dominant religion, practiced by virtually everyone, and Ramadan is strictly observed.
etiquette.es: El islam es la religión dominante, practicada por prácticamente todos, y el Ramadán se respeta estrictamente.
etiquette.quote: Islam is the dominant religion in the country and is practiced by virtually everyone. Ramadan is strictly observed.

etiquette.en: For the most part, try to accept the small tokens and gestures you are offered, such as drinks, tea and small gifts.
etiquette.es: En general, intenta aceptar los pequeños detalles que te ofrezcan, como refrescos, té o regalos pequeños.
etiquette.quote: For the most part, try to accept all the small tokens and gestures (cokes, tea, small gifts, etc.) that you are offered.

etiquette.en: Do not photograph military or government installations.
etiquette.es: No fotografíes instalaciones militares o gubernamentales.
etiquette.quote: Do not photograph military or government installations.

etiquette.en: When speaking to Nigeriens, make direct eye contact and try not to raise your voice.
etiquette.es: Al hablar con nigerinos, mantén contacto visual directo e intenta no levantar la voz.
etiquette.quote: When speaking to Nigeriens, make direct eye contact and try not to raise your voice.
